quests.instruction: IDENTIFY THE TARGET CONSONANT PHONEME IN THE WORD
quests.hint: Compare the two options for "sore": one is a voiceless alveolar fricative, the other a voiceless postalveolar fricative. Listen closely for the difference between them.
